main.description: A person's own fit ratings (1-10) for a Steam game's community tags, snapshotted at rating time. One record per game — the record key is the Steam appid, so re-rating a game overwrites its record in place rather than creating a new one. Written and read by steamtags (https://steamtags.bisks.net).

appid.description: The Steam application id of the game being rated. The record's rkey is this value as a string.

name.description: The game's Steam store name, snapshotted at rating time.

headerImage.description: URL of the game's Steam store header image, snapshotted at rating time.

steamid.description: The rater's SteamID64, present only if they'd verified their identity via Steam OpenID sign-in at the time this record was last written. Absent for anonymous/unverified ratings — this is never required.

tags.description: The community tags rated for this game. Sourced from SteamSpy's mirror of the game's Steam Store community tags.

updatedAt.description: When this record was last written, as an ISO 8601 datetime.

tag.description: A SteamSpy/Steam community tag name, e.g. "Roguelike" or "Atmospheric".

score.description: The rater's own judgement of how well this tag actually fits the game, 1 (not at all) to 10 (perfectly) — never algorithmically derived.

votes.description: SteamSpy's community vote count for this tag on this game, snapshotted at rating time. Not the rater's own vote — context for how established the tag is.
